visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor living room. A young woman with brown hair, wearing a black off-the-shoulder top and a patterned scarf, stands behind a large, tiered metal rack overflowing with dozens of cooked orange shrimp. She covers her mouth with her hand, displaying a look of genuine shock and surprise. (2) Cut to the woman sitting in a white office chair, surrounded by two muscular men. The men are shirtless and wearing patriotic-themed swimwear with stars and stripes. They strike exaggerated bodybuilding poses while the woman laughs uncontrollably, leaning back in her chair with her arms outstretched. (3) A man in a white t-shirt, presumably the host, speaks directly to the camera with the woman by his side. A graphic of a birthday cake appears briefly on screen. The background features a clean, white wall and a glimpse of a kitchen or hallway. (4) The woman is shown tasting the shrimp with a young girl in a yellow shirt. They are both smiling and gesturing towards the food. An older man in a grey t-shirt is then seen meticulously peeling and eating the shrimp from the large rack. (5) A surprise 'raid' occurs as men dressed in police uniforms enter the room. The woman looks bewildered, covering her mouth again. The two muscular dancers then reappear and perform around her, eventually lifting her into the air while she remains seated in her chair.
